description.p: BooN Transfer is a dual-pane file transfer client for SFTP, SCP, FTP and FTPS. It offers a familiar side-by-side local/remote workflow with saved sessions and a background transfer queue.

ul.li: SFTP and SCP over SSH, plus FTP and FTPS — all pure Rust (russh/rustls, no OpenSSL)
Password, SSH key and SSH-agent authentication with host-key verification
Saved sessions and a connection manager
Transfer queue with pause, resume, cancel, retry and SHA-256 verification
Directory synchronisation and a built-in text editor
Passwords stored in the system keyring, never in plain text
Tabs, detachable windows, light/dark themes, German and English UI

description.p: Initial release: SFTP, SCP, FTP and FTPS; transfer queue with pause/resume; directory sync; built-in editor; keyring credential storage; German and English UI.
